about.title: About Application
about.description: A reliable weather application providing accurate and direct data for your location around the clock.

hydration.title: Body Hydration
hydration.content: The weather is hot today. Make sure to drink plenty of water to stay healthy and active.

visibility.title: Safe Driving
visibility.content: Visibility may be low due to fog or dust. Please drive carefully and keep a safe distance from other cars.

devices.title: Device Safety
devices.content: High temperatures can affect your laptop and phone. Keep them in a cool, ventilated place.

productivity.title: Focus & Work
productivity.content: The current calm atmosphere is perfect for working or studying. A great time to get things done!

errors.network: Network error. Please check your internet connection!
errors.serverError: Weather server is not responding right now.
errors.locationDenied: Location permission denied. Please enable it from browser settings.
errors.locationUnavailable: Location unavailable. Please make sure GPS is turned on and try again.
errors.notSupported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser.
